name: duedillforge
displayName: duedillforge UA — юридичний due diligence за правом України
description: Multi-agent legal due diligence of a Ukrainian company on NotebookLM notebooks and project documents: per-block checklists, a verification ledger in which the program (not the model) decides whether «not found» may be written, a risk register (критичний / суттєвий / до відома), a request list for missing documents, and a DOCX report with an XLSX register in Ukrainian. Legislation comes from a dedicated NotebookLM notebook; Legal Data Hunter is the fallback when a norm is not in the notebooks.

output_folder.title: Output folder
output_folder.description: Where task folders are created. Default: ~/Documents/duedillforge, then ./outputs/duedillforge-work.

publish_folder.title: Publish folder
publish_folder.description: Where the finished report, register and request list are copied. Default: the host's outputs area when one exists (Cowork /mnt/user-data/outputs).

max_parallel_queries.title: Parallel NotebookLM queries
max_parallel_queries.description: Total number of NotebookLM queries in flight across all agents. Default 2. Not tested live; raise only after a trial run on a small notebook.

items_per_batch.title: Checklist items per agent run
items_per_batch.description: How many checklist items one block-reviewer run takes. Smaller batches resume more precisely after a pause.

findings_gate.title: Findings review gate
findings_gate.description: Stop for your review of critical findings before the report is written: auto (only when critical findings exist), on (always) or off (never).

review_iterations.title: Report review rounds
review_iterations.description: Maximum number of review rounds of the report (the first review plus revisions).

writer_model.title: Report writer model
writer_model.description: Model for report-writer: opus, fable or sonnet. An unknown value falls back to opus.
